summary: Coast of Skeletons is a 1965 British-South African adventure film directed by Robert Lynn, starring Richard Todd and Dale Robertson. It is a sequel to the 1963 film Death Drums Along the River and reuses characters from Edgar Wallace's 1911 novel Sanders of the River and Zoltán Korda's 1935 film based on it, but in a different story. The film was released in Germany under the title Sanders und das Schiff des Todes.
one_line: A 1965 British-South African adventure film directed by Robert Lynn, sequel to Death Drums Along the River, reusing Edgar Wallace's Sanders characters.
key_facts: Coast of Skeletons is a 1965 British-South African adventure film.
Coast of Skeletons was directed by Robert Lynn.
Coast of Skeletons stars Richard Todd and Dale Robertson.
Coast of Skeletons is a sequel to the 1963 film Death Drums Along the River.
Coast of Skeletons uses the characters from Edgar Wallace's 1911 novel Sanders of the River.
Coast of Skeletons also uses characters from Zoltán Korda's 1935 film based on the novel Sanders of the River.
The characters in Coast of Skeletons are placed in a totally different story than the earlier works.
Death Drums Along the River was a 1963 film that also used characters from Sanders of the River.
Coast of Skeletons was released in Germany as Sanders und das Schiff des Todes.
The German release title translates to Sanders and the Ship of Death in English.
